priority: P1 — prove classic-owned TagDuel freezes each participant's active deck at the correct consent boundary and never rereads later deck edits.

implementation.behavior: The host loadout is captured at lobby creation; seat 1's loadout is captured at acceptance; seat 2 edits before acceptance and the new loadout is captured; seat 3 accepts without edits. After the final consent, the actual TagDuel inventory is compared as a multiset against each seat's saved consent snapshot, while current active decks for seats 0/1 intentionally differ. All physical UIDs remain m0–m3 and player/collection/deck rows remain unchanged by TagDuel. The persisted TagDuel JSON is then reloaded through a fresh tagStore module instance; all four consent snapshots, physical UID inventory and seat ownership must survive restoration unchanged.
implementation.validation: Temporary SQLite; createPlayer/chooseStarterDeck; decks.openDeck/changeDeck; createTagLobby/acceptTag; physical seat extraction from core/reserves; TagDuel inventory conservation; Discord public/private payload builders.

limitations: Additional collection rows used for deck-swap fixtures exist only in a temporary SQLite database; no live player or production data is accessed.
Discord payloads are validated offline; no live guild/token test.
No new card effect is implemented or certified.
